1879059884.name: Raging Blade
1879059884.desc: Makes a full AoE attack, inflicting heavy damage.\n\nThis attack never misses on level opponents.

1879073196.name: Distraction
1879073196.desc: Your companion hampers archers, inhibiting their ability to fire and enraging them.

1879090220.name: Rock
1879090220.desc: Throw rock at far away things. Hurt things near far thing. Sometimes, make things bleed after.

1879096876.name: Wild Strike
1879096876.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879109292.name: Ceaseless Argument
1879109292.desc: The potency of Rune-keepers' writings is not hindered by repetition. This skill is hard to resist.

procEffects.description: DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Tactical Mastery
DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Finesse
DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Finesse
DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Finesse
DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Finesse
DNT - Lightning skills have a chance to increase Rune-keepers Finesse

1879197996.name: Return to Master
1879197996.desc: Your Companion will instantly return to your side.

1879229996.name: Guide to Stangard
1879229996.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Stangard in Eorlsmead.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879230252.name: Shadow
1879230252.desc:
You attack your enemy from every shadow, dealing devastating damage. 
 
 <rgb=#FF7700>Agonizing Maul becomes Sudden Maul. 
 
 Raking Claws becomes Bestial Claws. 
 
 Brutal Fangs becomes Shadow Fangs. 
 
 Eye Gash becomes Eye Gouge. 
 
 Snap becomes Snap! 
 
 Howl of Aggression becomes Howl from the Shadow. 
 
 Pack Flayers becomes Shadow Pack. 
 
</rgb>  <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind. 
 
 Increased damage from Stealth.
 
 Sudden Maul, Bestial Claws, and Pounce function as they are from stealth and cannot be Blocked, Parried or Evaded.</rgb>

1879230636.name: Shadow Pack
1879230636.desc: You mark your territory, decreasing up to four enemies mitigations. Upon exiting your marked territory, your enemies take a reduced version of the debuff.

1879231404.name: Ranged Onslaught
1879231404.desc: A powerful javelin deals direct damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879241644.name: Coda of the Eorlingas
1879241644.desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a harmful blast of light-based damage affecting nearby enemies and restoring a fair amount of power to you and nearby friendly targets and war-steeds.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879244844.name: Skill of the Eorlingas
1879244844.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Rohirrim Discipline your defensive capacity is increased.

1879250988.name: Oppressive Blow
1879250988.desc: A full-force strike against a target that has the potential to inspire your efforts against your enemies.

1879270572.name: Piercing Trap
1879270572.desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879275436.name: Volcanic Rune-stone
1879275436.desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground that deals damage-over-time to nearby enemies.\n\nThe Rune-stone will persist for 11s.

1879288364.name: Surety of Death
1879288364.desc: A resolute strike, dealing strong Light Damage over time.

1879305388.name: Heavy Smash
1879305388.desc: Treebeard smashes the ground with one heavy swing of his arm.

1879314860.name: Return to Dol Amroth
1879314860.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Dol Amroth, you're able to quickly return to Dol Amroth in western Gondor. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879338924.name: Injured Bat
1879338924.desc: Summons a friendly injured bat. It will 'walk it off.'

1879391404.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Elvish Longbowman)
1879391404.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879411756.name: Wild Black Donkey
1879411756.desc: Summons a loveable wild donkey travelling companion.

1879448748.name: Friendly Bear Cub
1879448748.desc: Summons a friendly bear cub to keep you company.

1879456428.name: Steed of Cardolan's Dawn
1879456428.desc: A steed for new beginnings and glorious adventures.

1879468972.name: Catch a Breath
1879468972.desc: You are able to catch your breath to restore morale and power.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a block or parry response.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 1% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 4% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 3% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 2% of your max power.

1879471276.name: Fire Pot
1879471276.desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge and set alight.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879480620.name: Ill Omened Crab
1879480620.desc: Summons a friendly crab who loves to surprise friends and strangers alike with a surprisingly realistic menacing countenance.

1879485996.name: Friend of the Wilds (Tomb-guardian)
1879485996.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879489324.name: Sacrifice
1879489324.desc: Your companion is able to bring you back from the brink of defeat. If you would have suffered a killing blow while active, your companion will lend you their will, restoring your Power and Morale.

1879490988.name: Potato Farmer's Fine Cow
1879490988.desc: Summons a fine cow to proudly display.

1879495340.name: Memory of Purification
1879495340.desc: A Memory of Purification can be used to cleanse corruptions and strike down gertheryg.

1879524140.name: Pungent Blight Mushroom
1879524140.desc: This blight mushroom looks especially potent and dangerous. Best leave it alone.
